# Unit test for method __setattr__ of class Register
def test_Register___setattr__(monkeypatch):
    render_calls = []
    nested_rule = Style(value="nested")
    flattened_rule = Style(value="flattened")

    def fake_render_rules(renderfuncs, rules):
        render_calls.append((renderfuncs, rules))
        return "\x1b[1m", (flattened_rule,)

    monkeypatch.setitem(
        Register.__setattr__.__globals__,
        "_render_rules",
        fake_render_rules,
    )

    register = Register()

    # An unmuted register renders and stores a new Style with flattened rules.
    source_style = Style(nested_rule, value="old value")
    register.example = source_style

    assert isinstance(register.example, Style)
    assert register.example == "\x1b[1m"
    assert register.example.rules == (flattened_rule,)
    assert register.example is not source_style
    assert render_calls == [(register.renderfuncs, source_style.rules)]

    # A muted register stores an empty Style while preserving its rules.
    register.is_muted = True
    render_calls.clear()

    muted_style = Style(nested_rule, value="old value")
    register.muted_example = muted_style

    assert isinstance(register.muted_example, Style)
    assert register.muted_example == ""
    assert register.muted_example.rules == muted_style.rules
    assert render_calls == []

    # Non-Style values are assigned unchanged.
    marker = object()
    register.other = marker

    assert register.other is marker

def test_Register___setattr__(monkeypatch):
    register = Register()

    rule = object()
    flattened_rule = object()
    render_calls = []

        render_calls.append((renderfuncs, rules))
        return "\x1b[31m", (flattened_rule,)

    monkeypatch.setitem(
        Register.__setattr__.__globals__,
        "_render_rules",
        fake_render_rules,
    )

    # An unmuted register renders and stores a new Style.
    register.red = Style(rule, value="stale value")

    assert isinstance(register.red, Style)
    assert str(register.red) == "\x1b[31m"
    assert register.red.rules == (flattened_rule,)
    assert render_calls == [(register.renderfuncs, (rule,))]

    # A muted register stores the rules but emits no rendered value.
    register.is_muted = True
    muted_style = Style(rule, value="\x1b[31m")
    register.red = muted_style

    assert isinstance(register.red, Style)
    assert str(register.red) == ""
    assert register.red.rules == (rule,)
    assert len(render_calls) == 1

    # Non-Style values are assigned without conversion.
    value = object()
    register.arbitrary = value
